final_masks = []
    for i in range(n):
        m = label == i + 1
        if m.any():
            others = ((label > 0) & ~m).astype(np.uint8)
            others_d = cv2.dilate(others, kernel).astype(bool)
            m = m & ~others_d
            m = (
                cv2.morphologyEx(m.astype(np.uint8), cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel).astype(
                    bool
                )
                if cv2.morphologyEx(m.astype(np.uint8), cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel).any()
                else m
            )
            m = largest_component(m)
        final_masks.append(m)

    # ---- polygons, with a verification pass guaranteeing no overlap ----
    occupied = np.zeros(shape, dtype=bool)
    out_x, out_y = [None] * n, [None] * n
